# Xragency - Premium Digital Agency Website

## Project Introduction

Xragency is a premium digital agency website built with modern web technologies, showcasing services for website creation, branding, SEO optimization, and AI-powered solutions. The project targets businesses seeking high-quality digital services across multiple markets (France, English-speaking countries, and Vietnam), offering multilingual support and localized pricing.

**Core Goals:**
- Present XR Agency's premium digital services professionally
- Provide comprehensive service information with detailed pricing
- Support international clients through trilingual interface (French, English, Vietnamese)
- Demonstrate technical excellence through modern web architecture

**Target Audience:**
- Businesses seeking premium web development services
- Companies requiring branding and identity design
- Organizations looking for SEO optimization and digital marketing
- International clients across French, English, and Vietnamese markets

## Technical Architecture

The project follows a modern React-based architecture using TanStack Start framework with server-side rendering capabilities:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Client Browser] --> B[TanStack Router]
    B --> C[Root Component]
    C --> D[Language Provider]
    C --> E[Query Client Provider]
    D --> F[Site Components]
    E --> G[Data Fetching]
    
    F --> H[Hero Section]
    F --> I[Services Section]
    F --> J[About Section]
    F --> K[Intelligence Section]
    F --> L[Pricing Section]
    F --> M[Work Portfolio]
    F --> N[Contact Form]
    
    O[Server Entry] --> P[Error Handling]
    O --> Q[SSR Rendering]
    P --> R[Error Page]
```

### Component Hierarchy

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[App Root] --> B[Navigation]
    A --> C[Main Content]
    C --> D[Hero]
    C --> E[Services]
    C --> F[About]
    C --> G[Intelligence]
    C --> H[Pricing]
    C --> I[Portfolio]
    C --> J[Contact]
    
    D --> K[Globe Animation]
    D --> L[Parallax Effects]
    E --> M[Service Cards]
    E --> N[Plan Selection]
```

### Data Flow Architecture

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant R as Router
    participant C as Component
    participant I as i18n
    participant S as Server
    
    U->>R: Navigate to page
    R->>C: Render component
    C->>I: Get translated content
    I-->>C: Return localized text
    C->>S: Fetch data if needed
    S-->>C: Return data
    C-->>U: Display content
```

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **Root Configuration**: `src/routes/__root.tsx` - Sets up global providers, error handling, and meta tags
- **Home Route**: `src/routes/index.tsx` - Main landing page with all sections
- **Server Entry**: `src/server.ts` - SSR configuration with error handling wrapper

### Core Modules
- **Internationalization**: `src/lib/i18n.tsx` - Multi-language support (FR/EN/VI) with currency conversion
- **Content Management**: `src/lib/content.ts` - Centralized service data, pricing, and translations
- **UI Components**: `src/components/ui/` - Reusable Radix UI components with Tailwind styling
- **Site Components**: `src/components/site/` - Business-specific components like Hero, Services, Pricing

### Configuration Approach
- **Build System**: `vite.config.ts` - Vite configuration with TanStack Start integration
- **Package Management**: `package.json` - Dependencies including React 19, TanStack ecosystem, Radix UI
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom animations and design system
- **TypeScript**: Full type safety with strict configuration

### External Dependencies
- **Framework**: TanStack Start for full-stack React application
- **UI Library**: Radix UI primitives for accessible components
- **State Management**: TanStack Query for server state management
- **Routing**: TanStack Router for file-based routing
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom animations
- **Forms**: React Hook Form with Zod validation

### Integration Points
- **Error Reporting**: `src/lib/error-capture.ts` - Error tracking and reporting
- **Analytics**: Integrated analytics setup in root configuration
- **SEO**: Meta tags and Open Graph configuration in routes
- **Performance**: Optimized asset loading and code splitting

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Multilingual Support:**
- Trilingual interface (French, English, Vietnamese)
- Localized pricing with currency conversion
- Language persistence in localStorage
- Browser language detection

**Service Showcase:**
- Comprehensive service descriptions with detailed plans
- Interactive pricing tables with feature comparisons
- Service workflow visualization
- Performance metrics and case studies

**Interactive Elements:**
- Parallax scrolling effects
- Animated globe visualization
- Smooth scroll navigation
- Responsive design across all devices

### Implementation Highlights

**Hero Section** (`src/components/site/Hero.tsx`):
- Video background with parallax effects
- Animated statistics display
- Global presence indicators
- Call-to-action buttons with smooth transitions

**Services Architecture** (`src/lib/content.ts`):
- Structured service data with multi-language support
- Detailed pricing plans with feature matrices
- Service comparison tables
- Workflow step definitions

**Pricing System** (`src/components/site/Pricing.tsx`):
- Dynamic currency conversion based on selected language
- Feature comparison between plans
- Popular plan highlighting
- Responsive pricing cards

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Loading
    Loading --> Ready: Content Loaded
    Ready --> LanguageSelection: User Changes Language
    LanguageSelection --> Ready: Language Applied
    Ready --> ServiceView: Click Service
    ServiceView --> Ready: Back to Home
    Ready --> ContactForm: Submit Inquiry
    ContactForm --> Ready: Form Submitted
```

**Performance Optimizations:**
- Code splitting by route
- Lazy loading of heavy components
- Optimized image and video assets
- Efficient re-renders with React.memo

**Accessibility Features:**
- Semantic HTML structure
- ARIA labels and roles
- Keyboard navigation support
- Screen reader compatibility

---

- [src/lib/i18n.tsx](src/lib/i18n.tsx)
- [src/lib/content.ts](src/lib/content.ts)
- [src/server.ts](src/server.ts)
